title: ochna oleifolia
intro: Ochna oleifolia, commonly known as the Mickey Mouse plant due to its unique flower shape, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ochnaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Ochna oleifolia include pain relief, wound healing, and anti-cancer effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ochna oleifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential benefits in modern medicine.
